uncited: They differ from their sibling [SDF NSVF Models](11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md) by utilizing a disentangled radiance field representation rather than a unified SDF-based approach.
The family relies on the `sdf_radiance_field` mechanism, where the neural network predicts both the signed distance to the surface and the view-dependent radiance [11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md].
This builds on the [MLPRender_Fea](52-mlprender-fea.md) architecture but adapts it for SDF-based implicit surface representation [11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md].
